## What's New

- Persist player names and observed death counts across plugin and server
  restarts in `BepInEx/config/br.com.midgard.valheimtelemetry.players`.
- Add the `valheim_player_deaths` metric with each known player's ID, name, and
  persisted death count, including players who are offline.
- Add player names as labels to the current and maximum health metrics.

## Notes

- Death counts include dead-state transitions observed while the plugin is
  running; they are not imported from Valheim player profiles.
- Current and maximum health metrics are available when the server has the
  player's health ZDO.
